Bash(cd /home/yl/DL/STUDY/MachineLearning-master && find . -name "*.py" -type f | while read f; do
  total=$\(wc -l < "$f"\)
  # Skip empty files and files with fewer than 20 lines
  if [ "$total" -lt 20 ]; then
    continue
  fi
  
  # Count comment lines: lines where first non-whitespace char is #, excluding shebang \(#!\)
  comment_lines=$\(grep -cP '^\\s*#\(?!!\)' "$f" 2>/dev/null || echo 0\)
  
  # Count docstring lines using a python one-liner for accuracy
  docstring_lines=$\(python3 -c "
import ast, sys
try:
    with open\('$f', 'r'\) as fh:
        source = fh.read\(\)
    tree = ast.parse\(source\)
    count = 0
    for node in ast.walk\(tree\):
        if isinstance\(node, \(ast.FunctionDef, ast.AsyncFunctionDef, ast.ClassDef, ast.Module\)\):
            if \(node.body and isinstance\(node.body[0], ast.Expr\) and
                isinstance\(node.body[0].value, \(ast.Constant, ast.Str\)\)\):
                doc_node = node.body[0].value
                if hasattr\(doc_node, 'value'\) and isinstance\(doc_node.value, str\):
                    lines = doc_node.value.split\('\\n'\)
                    count += len\(lines\)
                elif hasattr\(doc_node, 's'\):
                    lines = doc_node.s.split\('\\n'\)
                    count += len\(lines\)
    print\(count\)
except:
    print\(0\)
" 2>/dev/null\)
  
  total_comment=$\(\(comment_lines + docstring_lines\)\)
  
  if [ "$total" -gt 0 ]; then
    pct=$\(python3 -c "print\(f'{\($total_comment / $total\) * 100:.1f}'\)"\)
  else
    pct="0.0"
  fi
  
  echo "$pct|$f|$total|$total_comment"
done | sort -t'|' -k1 -n | head -15)
